environment.description: Same application deployed on EC2 behind ALB, but the ALB is associated with an AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL has three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action overridden to Count (not Block), (2) Priority 200 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default action (Block), and (3) Priority 300 - a custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP. The WebACL default action is Allow. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to CloudWatch with a metric filter alarm on 403 responses, but this is observability only. The application also has PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and runs with --preload flag for gunicorn memory optimization.

config.lb: ALB with default listener on 443, forwarding all traffic to target group on 8080
config.alb_rules: single default rule: forward all to target group
config.observability: ALB access logs to S3, CloudWatch metric filter on 403 count
